china-1922:p1010_1.rationale: Continued list of committee members and officers of the British Chambers of Commerce with their firms; textual roster with no quantities.

china-1922:p1010_2.rationale: Directory of local British chambers of commerce in Chinese ports and their secretaries or officers; textual roster.

china-1922:p1013_1.rationale: Directory of American chambers of commerce and associations with addresses and secretaries; textual.

china-1922:p1013_2.rationale: Textual list of foreign powers and the territories they hold in China (Hongkong, Kwantung, Macao etc.). This is foreign possession on Chinese territory, but it mixes leased territories and colonies. No existing tag covers a list of foreign-held territories exactly.
review_questions: Should a tag for foreign-held or leased territories be added? foreign-concessions was not used because the list covers colonies and leased territories.

china-1922:p1014_1.rationale: Weihaiwei 1919 trade values: imports and exports by steamers and junks, with totals in dollars and sterling.

china-1922:p1015_1.rationale: Budget of the Japanese civil administration at Tsingtao for 1921, with a 1920 comparison and revenue and expenditure items for the railway and local works.

china-1922:p1020_1.rationale: Descriptive list of mail steamship companies with nationality and routes; the content is textual.

china-1922:p1021_1.rationale: List of register and conference line steamship companies with flags and remarks; textual.

china-1922:p1021_2.rationale: List of steamship companies making occasional sailings, with flags; textual roster.

china-1922:p1022_1.rationale: Numbered list of steamship companies operating mainly in Far Eastern waters, with flags and remarks; textual.
